tabs.help.faq1.question: How do I send crypto?
tabs.help.faq1.answer: Tap the Send button on the home screen, enter the recipient address and amount, then confirm the transaction. Ruma takes care of delivering the token where the recipient wants it.
tabs.help.faq2.question: What is best in Ruma?
tabs.help.faq2.answer: With Ruma you can send and recieve digital assets seamlessly to any user on many networks, without having to ever touch swaps or bridges
